# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 44 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Confession

---

**1** 'O my children, I was the cause of all your suffering and toil upon the earth. Had I not eaten of the forbidden tree, none of this would have come upon you.'

**2** All her children wept and said: 'Mother, do not condemn yourself, for God is merciful.'

**3** Eve said: 'I confess my sin before God and before all of you, and I hope in God's mercy that he will forgive me.'

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
